subject: Postponed architecture orientation — propose condensed follow-up
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana.patel@brightwavehealth.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@brightwavehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Architecture orientation — Tue Jun 15 @ 9:00am PT (agenda + invite)

Hi Sana / Tom,

Thanks again for setting this up. Per our call, I’ve scheduled a 60‑minute architecture orientation for Tue, Jun 15 at 9:00 AM PT. The goal is to validate integration patterns and discussion items that will affect the pilot timeline. Short agenda: 

- 5m intros and goals
- 15m current infra & dataflow review (Brightwave)
- 25m Redwood serving architecture & integration options (model routing, KV cache, security controls)
- 10m open Q&A and next steps

I attached a quick agenda and the network diagram you shared; please let me know if you want to add any items. Calendar invite is live: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123def456

If anyone else from the data/infra team wants to join, please add them to the invite — the more context the better.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 415‑555‑0192

Attachment stubs: redwood-architecture-orientation-agenda.pdf (3 pages), brightwave-network-diagram.png (1 image)
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana.patel@brightwavehealth.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@brightwavehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:06:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up — we were in the meeting room, missed you

Hi Sana / Tom,

We were in the meeting room for the 9:00 AM PT orientation but didn’t see anyone join. I waited for about 10 minutes and then dropped to let our engineers move on with another short block. No worries — things come up.

Would you like to reschedule a condensed 45‑minute session that focuses on integration touchpoints (data flow + auth) rather than the full orientation? Two windows on my side that are open this week: Wed Jun 16 at 10:00 AM PT or Thu Jun 17 at 2:00 PM PT. If neither works, send a couple of times that match your data engineering lead and we’ll prioritize.

If you prefer, we can also do a 20‑minute sync just to triage blockers and then book a longer follow-up.

Thanks — please let me know what works and I’ll send an updated invite.

Best,
Rafael

Hi Rafael,

So sorry — we had an emergency pull on the data pipeline this morning and our lead was pulled into triage. That cascaded and we didn’t get anyone into the meeting room. My apologies for the no‑show.

We absolutely want the orientation. Of the times you suggested, Wed Jun 16 at 10:00 AM PT would work best for Tom and me. If possible, can we keep it to 45 minutes and focus on the data ingress path and auth/keys? Also, two quick asks before the call: 

1) Can you share a short checklist of items we should have handy (sample logs, firewall rules, example payload)?
2) Any constraints on bringing a developer who might need hands‑on access (we may want them in the meeting).

Thanks for the patience — we’ll be online for Wed 10:00.

Hi Sana / Tom — thanks for the update and no problem on earlier. Wed Jun 16 at 10:00 AM PT is confirmed (45 minutes). I’ve updated the invite to reflect the condensed agenda and attached a 1‑page checklist.

Quick notes:
- Please have a sample JSON payload and an example public IP/range for your egress so we can validate firewall rules quickly.
- Bringing a developer is fine; we’ll give them a short walkthrough and share a sandbox token for testing during the call.
- We’ll keep the session to 45 minutes: 10m goals, 20m integration + network, 10m auth/KMS discussion, 5m next steps.

Marissa (copied) from our solutions team will join to run the integration demo and validate network settings. Marissa — I gave you the 10:00 PT slot; can you confirm you’re good to lead the demo?
